query: I believe they excluded the early-time high spatial resolution and unresolved AMI-LA datapoints.
answer:
Based on the provided evidence, you are correct. The researchers fit a simple power-law to the rest-frame emission of the approaching and receding components of MAXI J1820, excluding the early-time high spatial resolution and unresolved AMI-LA data points.

Specifically, this is stated in the following excerpt from the paper:

"To study the XRB jet ejecta population more broadly, we fit a simple powerlaw to the rest-frame emission of the approaching and receding components of MAXIJ1820, excluding the early-time high spatial resolution and unresolved AMI-LA datapoints."

This exclusion was done to ensure that only well-resolved and reliable data points were used in the fitting process.

Would you like more details on any specific part of this finding or another aspect related to the study?
